dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp white perimeters with jagged, high-frequency edge geometry. These rings enclose dark internal regions, with the most prominent examples located along the mid-dorsal ridge and posterior-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of solid white pixel clusters along the dorsal-most ridge where individual annuli merge into elongated, high-intensity blobs. Discrete, low-density white clusters are scattered across the lower-lateral region against a predominantly dark background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent obtuse triangle is formed by the centroids of three large annuli at the peak of the dorsal curve. A secondary linear chain of four centroids follows the longitudinal axis from the mid-section toward the posterior.
